description: cpu_timeout enforcement probe: one CPU breach (must be KILLED), two compliant nodes (must SURVIVE).

steps.desc: busy-loop burns 1 core; cpu_timeout=2 must reap it well before wall=60
sleeps 4s (~0 CPU); cpu_timeout=2 must NOT fire on idle wall time
burns ~1 CPU-s then exits; cpu_timeout=5 must NOT fire (work < budget)
steps.cmd: echo CPU-START; end=$((SECONDS+1)); while [ $SECONDS -lt $end ]; do :; done; echo CPU-DONE
